source_caption:
While preparing for Moneyball, Brad Pitt practiced the same sunflower seed habits as real-life baseball executive Billy Beane. Beane was known for constantly chewing and spitting seeds during tense games, and Pitt adopted the habit to capture his restless energy on screen.

Moneyball (2011), directed by Bennett Miller, starring Brad Pitt, Jonah Hill, Philip Seymour Hoffman. A sharp and compelling sports drama that follows the Oakland A’s attempt to reinvent baseball using data and analytics, turning an underdog season into a revolution in the sport.
